paragraphs: Abba Guryan of Tzaydan, in the name of Abba Gurya: chapter Asarah Yuchasin, last mishnah, 82a. In Rabbah, beginning of Esther: Abba Oryan of Sidon (in Yalkut: Guryan) said five things in the name of Rabban Gamliel.
